en.why_it_matters: The reason is the collision, not either name by itself. Knocked Loose's physical, fractured hardcore and Denzel Curry's high-impact Southern rap share a taste for pressure and release without pretending to be the same music; putting them on one co-headlining bill, then adding Superheaven and Boundaries, turns The Anthem into a deliberately heavy cross-genre room rather than a routine tour stop.
en.trip_verdict: If October 3 is open in DC, I would actively make room for The Anthem and take the full four-act bill rather than cherry-picking a headliner. The same pairing is touring several cities, so there is no reason to chase it elsewhere.
en.listen_before: Knocked Loose — You Won't Go Before You're Supposed To; Denzel Curry — Strictly 4 The Scythe

es.why_it_matters: La razón es el choque, no cualquiera de los dos nombres por separado. El hardcore físico y quebrado de Knocked Loose y el rap sureño de alto impacto de Denzel Curry trabajan la presión y la descarga desde lenguajes distintos; ponerlos como co-headliners y sumar a Superheaven y Boundaries convierte The Anthem en una noche deliberadamente pesada y cross-genre, no en una parada rutinaria de gira.
es.trip_verdict: Si el 3 de octubre está libre en DC, sí le haría espacio a The Anthem y llegaría para vivir la cartelera completa en vez de escoger sólo un headliner. La misma pareja recorre varias ciudades, así que no hace falta perseguirla fuera de Washington.
es.listen_before: Knocked Loose — You Won't Go Before You're Supposed To; Denzel Curry — Strictly 4 The Scythe
